sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:31

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:31:1
items.html:
The Hassadim and Gevurot that enlarge the posterior of ZON and return them to face to face are the matter of the posterior of AVI that fell: As he goes on to explain, the state of AVI of Nekudim, too, was at first back to back, like ZON, and therefore they too were in the phase of “and their posteriors inward,” that is, that their NHY were hidden and covered in the posterior of Ima, which is the phase of the original HGT before the NHY came out from them, that is, the Bina of direct light before she emanated the NHY of direct light, as above. But afterwards, through the coupling of AB SAG, the bottom Hey descended from the Einayim of Keter, and HB returned to the Rosh [head]. Then the Yesod of AK bestowed upon them its drop, which is the secret of Vav and a point, which became MAN [female waters] in them; and then the NHY of Keter clothed in them in the secret of the illumination of the revealed NHY, and then AVI coupled face to face upon their MAN, as written above in Part 6.
And you find that the coupling of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] of face to face of AVI upon the MAN of the Yesod of AK likewise came about through the attainment of the new revealed NHY that they attained from Keter, for from this their coupling of face to face was drawn. Therefore afterwards, when the phase of the Guf [body] of this coupling was bestowed upon the ZAT and they broke, the phase of the Gadlut of AVI also descended for this reason to the phase of HGT and VAK [six ends]; for this Gadlut is neither more nor less than the phase of their new revealed NHY, in which there was illumination of Hochma and GAR [first three], and now they fell to VAK, meaning that the illumination of GAR departed from them and they became a phase of posteriors that are not complete.
